description: This header file declares exported API functions for the Http Webs Session Object, including creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions.

methods.name: HttpCreateWebsSession
methods.description: Creates a new Webs Session object, returning a handle to it.

methods.name: HttpWssoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Webs Session Object.

methods.name: HttpWssoRemove
methods.description: Removes the Webs Session Object instance.

methods.name: HttpWssoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls objects necessary for Webs Session Object functionality.
